name: buster
label: BUSTER
title: Buster: a chaos filter for HEART, named after the dog
summary: Sits in front of a server and tampers with its answers on purpose: forges an ETag, flips a letter in a form, drops an affordance, lies about the rung. Each plugin breaks one rule of the HEART spec and says what the client must do about it; each mutation ends as a pass or a FAIL, seeded so any failure replays exactly, and nothing corrupted is ever cached. Basically Unstoppable Saboteur Terrierizing Every Representation.
